name: Massive Rabbit 40
author: Gautammsharma
description: Outlined gray checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, border-color becomes #C3CF34, border-color becomes #4d4d4d. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes to #2F3300, border-color becomes #454B00, top becomes 2px. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 2px #dfec5065.
